system.longDesc: You can sow confusion among friends and foes alike.

degree0.desc: As a major action, you can make a Communi cation (Deception) test opposed by an opponent’s Will power (Self-Discipline); if you succeed, your opponent cannot perform stunts until the end of your next turn.

degree1.desc: Your targets become too focused on you to do anything else. When you use the Over Here! exploration stunt, the bonus your allies gain is +2 instead of +1, and you gain a +1 bonus yourself.

degree2.desc: When you use a Communication focus in combat and roll doubles, you gain +1 SP.
